main.description: Stock state for a single purchasable listing. Separate from the listing because inventory changes continuously while listing metadata does not; writing stock should not rewrite title, images, or description. Convention: use the subject listing's record key as this record's key, so stock updates are idempotent puts.

subject.description: AT URI of the listing this stock state applies to. Availability belongs to purchasable listings, never to a productGroup.

availability.description: Availability status. Open/advisory knownValues; richer states (backorder, per-location) are additive.

quantity.description: Units available, if the seller tracks a count

managed.description: True if quantity is maintained by an authoritative system and can be relied on; false or absent means availability is the seller's coarse assertion

updatedAt.description: When this stock state was asserted. The freshness signal for consumers; there is no separate createdAt because only the current state is meaningful.
